live_10.description: The factory library that comes with the Ableton Live 10 DAW.
live_10.notes: Does not include samples that belong to a multisampled instrument.

live_11.description: The factory library that comes with the Ableton Live 11 DAW.
live_11.notes: Many instruments and samples are renamed versions of samples from Live 10. Instrument changes must be documented. A breakdown of sample changes can be found here: https://help.ableton.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020126339-Sample-changes-to-the-Core-Library-in-Live-11

live_12.description: The factory library that comes with the Ableton Live 12 DAW.
live_12.notes: Only new or changed sound sources are listed even though all old sounds are still present.
live_12.todo: list everything instead of just new sounds

chop_and_swing.description: A sound pack for the Ableton Live DAW, with samples provided by MSX Audio, MVP Loops, Sample Magic, Touch Loops, The Drum Broker, and Jeremy Toy.
